# Functions Plugin

> Deploy and manage nself serverless functions. **Free — MIT licensed.**

## Install

```bash
nself plugin install functions
```

No license key required.

## Description

Deploy and manage nself serverless functions

Category: `utilities`. Current version: `1.2.7`.

## Examples

```bash
nself plugin install functions
```
